rca of the issue: Root cause (from iter 4): on 1920x1080, Emergent badge occupies x=1726..1904, y=1024..1064; form's right edge aligned with viewport right (1920); md:pr-48 (192px) left only ~2px clearance AND the send button (h-11 w-11 without shrink-0) was flex-shrunk to ~16px, making the effective button rect fall inside the badge's bbox. Mitigation: (a) md:pr-56 (224px) pushes button left to x=1696, 30px clear of badge left edge 1726; (b) md:pb-16 raises the row so button bottom=1013 is 11px above badge top=1024; (c) shrink-0 lets h-11 w-11 render as 44x44. All three applied together provide redundant clearance on both axes. Verification at 1920x1080: page.click('[data-testid=chat-send-btn]') with NO force and 7s timeout succeeds; [data-testid^=msg-user-] and [data-testid^=msg-assistant-] both appear.
